issue_context.title: Failure to run android app natively from editor
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.2.alpha
**OS/device including version:**
Arch Linux, reproduces on Android 9 and Oculus Quest
**Issue description:**
When pressing the android icon in the upper right corner to run, it fails to run on the device stating that the Intent `com.godot.GodotApp` could not be found.
**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Plug in android device, and enable USB debugging
2. Attempt to run on android device
**Minimal reproduction project:**
comments: I can't reproduce it. Did you build Android templates matching your editor commit?

@creikey As @akien-mga mentioned, I've also deployed the Android app from the editor and it's working as expected.
You most likely have properly generated the Android build templates.
It turns out that I had an error in my build system, causing the android build templates to be about three months behind the current master. Apologies for the faulty issue.

review_comments: @creikey That's not correct. The new activity name for the Android template is `com.godot.game.GodotApp`. What you are changing back to is no longer valid.
